semantics.sourceVsDerived: artId is Rules.Image or the rulesId fallback; artImageOverride is only Art[artId].Image when explicitly present. sourceFileId is that art override or artId. Raw INI properties stay in originalRules and artSections. filenameCandidates and derived* fields are derived and unconfirmed.
semantics.null: No explicit source property or source section. No endpoint, timing, offset, or asset existence is fabricated.
semantics.flags: voxel/theater/newTheater use the original art.ini documented default no. originalFlags preserves null when absent; referenced sections are not made to inherit their parent flags.
semantics.identifiers: Original section IDs, source string values and case are preserved. Lookup maps artSections and sequenceSections use uppercase keys for case-insensitive INI lookup. Candidate filenames are lowercase for the asset tools.
semantics.sequences: Each sequences value contains original comma-separated tokens with decimal integer tokens parsed as JSON integers; optional compass-facing tokens remain strings. Original string values, source lines and comments remain in sequenceSections. Start/count/facing-stride interpretation is documented at original art.ini lines 9558-9564.
semantics.animationOffsets: Animation relativeOffsets read the specific reference key plus X/Y/ZAdjust/YSort, falling back to the undamaged slot key for damaged references. Each resolved component records its exact property and source line. Null means absent, not an invented zero.
semantics.animationPlayback: Animation Start/End/LoopStart/LoopEnd/LoopCount/Rate are copied numerically without changing range endpoints or clock units. Missing bounds remain null. Inline AnimActive-style lists are copied separately.
semantics.candidateTheaters: For G/N building namespace stems, generic substitutes character 2 with G and temperate with T, including referenced animations/bibs/buildups and building turret candidates. GAYARD -> GGYARD/GTYARD; GAYARDMK -> GGYARDMK/GTYARDMK. This does not imply original NewTheater=yes or presence in any MIX.
semantics.optionalParts: A unit voxel Turret=yes enables unconfirmed artId+tur/artId+barl candidates; explicit multiple turrets add suffixes 1..count-1. Explicit building TurretAnim IDs are source data; derived barrel suffixes are unconfirmed. All optional parts require parent archive-index validation.
semantics.counts: 47 logical unit types includes the 4 stolen-tech types and groups four shared pairs. There are 51 separate unit rules entries, of which 47 are ordinary country variants and 4 require stolen technology. Auxiliary entries are separate and normallyTrainable=false. Source Rules.Trainable is a veteran flag, not treated as production authorization.
semantics.buildingProduction: normallyTrainable on buildings denotes ordinary sidebar construction availability only; GACNST/NACNST are mcvDeployment with TechLevel=-1. All original report variants are retained independently.
semantics.parser: Semicolon starts an INI comment; active section/property names are read case-insensitively and raw value strings are trimmed. No original or third-party game implementation was read. No fetch, conversion, build or game execution was performed.

metadataAmbiguities.detail: Every filename is a candidate until confirmed in the parent MIX index. Generic G and temperate T substitutions are derived, not original Image values. Optional turret and barrel suffixes are hypotheses and may not exist.

Both base shipyard art sections omit NewTheater; their animation sections have NewTheater=yes. Their base G/T substitutions are provided from the building namespace as candidates without changing original flags.
NAPSIS base art omits NewTheater; retain false default and original null while offering building namespace candidates.

Some damaged animation sections (for example GAOREP_AD and NACLON_AD) comment out or omit NewTheater even though the undamaged section enables it. Each section retains its own explicit flags; no inheritance is fabricated.
Original rules specify TurretCount=4 and WeaponCount=1 with IsChargeTurret=true; do not reduce to one turret because there is one weapon.

Original rules specify TurretCount=4 and WeaponCount=13. Weapon1..13 are original one-based keys; the explicit *TurretWeapon and *TurretIndex values are preserved verbatim and are zero-based source integers.
BibShape and Buildup often name files without a corresponding art section. The direct source ID and derived G/T candidates are retained; missing sections do not imply missing archive files.
Original IvanSequence and CIvanSequence Deploy=244,15,0 carry the source comment "### Bad/missing frames in Ivan". Values remain unchanged and require frame-count confirmation after conversion.

turretCount and weaponCount are null unless explicitly present in rules. derivedTurretSlots/derivedWeaponSlots are conveniences computed from Turret and active weapon keys; they do not claim source declarations or asset availability.
Start, End, LoopStart, LoopEnd, LoopCount and Rate are original numeric values. No inclusive/exclusive endpoint convention, timing conversion, or missing frame bound is inferred.

The four shared logical groups retain separate rules entries and exact art and country restrictions. LCRF and SAPC have different original TechLevel values; only ENGINEER/SENGINEER share the same base art ID.
Original wall art uses ToOverlay and DamageLevels=3 with no Buildup. Wall connection and damage frame layout must be confirmed from the SHP; it is not inferred from infantry sequence metadata.
